title: Choose an enquiry

blocks.heading: Choose an enquiry
blocks.text: A research topic identifies an issue that can be investigated with accessible evidence in a specified setting. Choose a safe, feasible focus rather than an entire national problem. Learners may collect in groups, but each presents an individual report; the written examination asks about the enquiry, which is not formally assessed coursework.
context_tags: original teaching; fictional examples where stated

blocks.heading: Worked enquiry connection
blocks.text: Suggest a feasible topic for learners who can safely observe an accessible public bus stop for two afternoons but cannot interview travellers. Compare recorded bus arrival intervals at that stop on the two stated afternoons, with a safe approved observation point. It fits accessible evidence and avoids unsupported questions about private reasons.
